id.description: Unique stable item identifier stored in `value`.

disabled.description: Prevents selecting or transferring the item from the available list. Already-selected disabled items remain removable.

items.description: Full item pool. Item IDs must be unique; duplicate IDs after the first are ignored. The component never mutates this array.

value.description: Unique IDs currently selected in the list. Supports `bind:value`. Unknown IDs are ignored and dropped on the next update.

leftLabel.description: Accessible and visible label for the compact selection list.

rightLabel.description: Label used in the selection count and transfer announcements.

unsupportedProps.name: onValueChange
unsupportedProps.description: Called with the next selected value after an option is toggled.
